question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **TELEOLOGICAL**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Purpose-driven .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **teleological** refers to the explanation of phenomena based on their purpose or goal.
